title: Joseph of Copertino's levitation records

tellings.quote: have looked at so much data I mean I have the Joseph of copertino Records right yeah and been reading them and they're pretty intense

plain: Joseph of Copertino, an Italian Catholic saint, is said to have risen into the air, and records of those levitations still exist. The religious scholar Diana Pasulka tells Michels she has the Joseph of Copertino records and has been reading them, and calls them "pretty intense", in a conversation that also names the physicist Hal Puthoff; she does not say what in them she finds so striking.
